calls.video_title: S&P Global Stock: Buy, Hold, or Sell? | SPGI Stock Analysis
calls.thesis: AVOID / not a buying opportunity — reiterates his 19 Aug verdict: 'I don't think so' at these valuations. Stock down 18%+ in 2026 and still not recovered from the SaaS-apocalypse lows, but DCF $311 is well below the $403 market price; first tracked Parkevtate SPGI call, no flip.
calls.base_case: DCF fair value $311 vs $403 market; forward P/E 19.95 looks fairly priced but rich on DCF. Sales tripled $5B (2017) to $16B+ TTM; operating margin ~44%, guided +~50bp.
calls.bull_case: Strong data-quality moat; API usage up 5x Q1->Q2 as business shifts seat-based to consumption pricing; ratings guided low-to-mid single-digit growth.
calls.bear_case: ROIC fell from 35%+ pre-2022 to ~10.5%, barely above WACC; higher rates delay bond issuance; consumption-model monetisation still unproven.

calls.thesis: Added $1,000 to a $114k position (gains down to ~$7k). Stock down 24% YTD on 'SaaS apocalypse' Anthropic-plugin fears plus rates. Market intelligence is ~30% of revenue but lower-margin than the ratings/indices wide-moat businesses; ETF AUM $3T->~$6T since 2023 is a tailwind; debt-refi wall sustains issuance activity. Prior BUY (Sep 28), no flip.
